am.L: በይሁዳ ከተሞች የሚኖሩት የእስራኤል ልጆች ግን፣ ሮብዓም ነገሠባቸው።
am.B: በይሁዳ ከተሞች በሚኖሩት የእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ግን ሮብዓም ነገሠ።
am.R: ይሁን እንጂ ሮብዓም በይሁዳ ከተሞች በሚኖሩት እስራኤላውያን ላይ አሁንም ይገዛ ነበር።

hi.L: पर [जहाँ तक] {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} [की बात है] जो यहूदा के नगरों में रहते थे, उन पर रहबाम राज्य करता रहा।
hi.B: पर जो इस्राएली यहूदा के नगरों में रहते थे, उन पर रहबाम राज्य करता रहा।
hi.R: पर जो इस्राएली यहूदा के नगरों में रहते थे, उन पर रहबाम अब भी राज्य करता रहा।

ru.L: А {{gender:дети Израиля|сыны Израиля}}, живущие в городах Иуды, — над ними царствовал Ровоам.
ru.B: Но над израильтянами, которые жили в городах Иуды, царствовал Ровоам.
ru.R: Но израильтянами, которые жили в городах Иуды, Ровоам продолжал править.

ja.L: しかし、ユダの町々に住んでいたイスラエルの子らについては、レハブアムが彼らの上に王となった。
ja.B: しかし、ユダの町々に住んでいたイスラエルの人々は、レハブアムが治めた。
ja.R: けれども、ユダの町々に住んでいたイスラエルの人々は、それからもレハブアムが治めました。

uk.L: А {{gender:нащадки Ізраїля|сини Ізраїля}}, які жили в містах Юдеї, — над ними царював Ровоам.
uk.B: Але Ровоам царював над ізраїльтянами, які жили в містах Юдеї.
uk.R: Але Ровоам і далі правив ізраїльтянами, які жили в містах Юдеї.

decisions.choice: the Israelites: here the people of all the tribes
decisions.reason: In this verse "Israelites" still has its wide sense, the people descended from Jacob, and so includes the people of Judah and any from the northern tribes who had settled in Judah's towns. From verse 20 on, "Israel" alone names the northern kingdom.

decisions.choice: but: set against the departure of Israel
decisions.reason: The sentence puts "the Israelites who lived in the towns of Judah" first, to set them against the rest of Israel, who had just gone home (verse 16).

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word covers both cities and small walled towns. "Towns" fits most of the places in Judah.

decisions.choice: still
decisions.reason: Readable adds "still" to show that Judah stayed with Rehoboam while the rest went away.

decisions.choice: "los hijos de Israel" (L); "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets: Spanish "hijos" and "israelitas" already take in women, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (Literal); Waisraeli (Balanced, Readable), without a gender span
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span here; Swahili "wana" and "Waisraeli" already take in men and women, so there is no second wording and no span, as the Pentateuch and Samuel notes set.

decisions.choice: no gender span for "con cháu / dân Y-sơ-ra-ên"
decisions.reason: As in Samuel, Vietnamese "con cháu" and "dân" already include men and women, so the English gender setting has no second wording here.

decisions.choice: "이스라엘 자손" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "자손" already includes men and women, so Korean has no second wording for the gender setting; as in Samuel, no gender span is used in this block.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As at 11:2 and in the Old Testament terms: "filhos de Israel" and "israelitas" already take in women, so Portuguese has no second wording for the English gender setting; the same in verses 24 and 33.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "የእስራኤል ልጆች" (Literal, Balanced), "እስራኤላውያን" (Readable), here and in verses 24 and 33
decisions.reason: As in the Amharic Pentateuch and Samuel: "ልጆች" already includes daughters and "እስራኤላውያን" names men and women alike, so the setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}}" (L); "इस्राएली" (B, R), no span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note: Literal mirrors the English span; Balanced and Readable say "इस्राएली", already inclusive. The same in verses 24 and 33.

decisions.choice: bene yisra'el "イスラエルの子ら" (L), "イスラエルの人々" (B, R), no gender span
decisions.reason: As 9:20; the Japanese words already include men and women.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלַ֞ח הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת־אֲדֹרָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־הַמַּ֔ס וַיִּרְגְּמ֨וּ כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל בּ֛וֹ אֶ֖בֶן וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם הִתְאַמֵּץ֙ לַעֲל֣וֹת בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֔ה לָנ֖וּס יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent the king Rehoboam Adoram, who [was] over the forced labor, and stoned all Israel him [with] stone, and he died; and the king Rehoboam made himself strong to go up into the chariot to flee [to] Jerusalem.

en.L: And King Rehoboam sent Adoram, who [was] over the forced labor, and all Israel stoned him with stones, and he died. And King Rehoboam made haste to go up into the chariot to flee [to] Jerusalem.
en.B: King Rehoboam then sent Adoram, the officer in charge of the forced labor, but all Israel stoned him to death. King Rehoboam managed to get up into his chariot and escape to Jerusalem.
en.R: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoram to the people. Adoram was in charge of the men who were forced to work for the king. But all the people of Israel threw stones at him until he died. King Rehoboam hurried to jump into his chariot, and he escaped to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y el rey Roboam envió a Adoram, que [estaba] sobre el trabajo forzado, y todo Israel lo apedreó con piedras, y murió. Y el rey Roboam se apresuró a subir al carro para huir [a] Jerusalén.
es.B: Luego el rey Roboam envió a Adoram, el encargado del trabajo forzado, pero todo Israel lo mató a pedradas. El rey Roboam logró subir a su carro y escapar a Jerusalén.
es.R: Entonces el rey Roboam envió a Adoram a hablar con el pueblo. Adoram estaba a cargo de los hombres que eran obligados a trabajar para el rey. Pero todo el pueblo de Israel le tiró piedras hasta que murió. El rey Roboam se subió deprisa a su carro y escapó a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et le roi Roboam envoya Adoram, qui [était préposé] à la corvée, et tout Israël le lapida avec des pierres, et il mourut. Et le roi Roboam se hâta de monter sur le char pour s’enfuir [à] Jérusalem.
fr.B: Le roi Roboam envoya alors Adoram, le responsable de la corvée, mais tout Israël le lapida, et il mourut. Le roi Roboam parvint à monter sur son char et à s’enfuir à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Ensuite, le roi Roboam a envoyé Adoram vers le peuple. Adoram était chargé des hommes qu’on obligeait à travailler pour le roi. Mais tout le peuple d’Israël lui a jeté des pierres jusqu’à ce qu’il meure. Le roi Roboam s’est dépêché de sauter dans son char, et il s’est enfui à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Mfalme Rehoboamu akamtuma Adoramu, aliyekuwa [msimamizi] juu ya kazi ya kulazimishwa, na Israeli wote wakampiga kwa mawe, akafa. Mfalme Rehoboamu akajikaza kupanda garini ili akimbilie Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme Rehoboamu akamtuma Adoramu, msimamizi wa kazi ya kulazimishwa, lakini Israeli wote wakampiga kwa mawe hata akafa. Mfalme Rehoboamu akafaulu kupanda gari lake na kukimbilia Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme Rehoboamu akamtuma Adoramu kwa watu. Adoramu alikuwa msimamizi wa watu waliolazimishwa kumfanyia mfalme kazi. Lakini watu wote wa Israeli wakamtupia mawe mpaka akafa. Mfalme Rehoboamu akaharakisha kuruka ndani ya gari lake, akakimbilia Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Vua Rô-bô-am sai A-đô-ram, người cai quản lao dịch, nhưng cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá ông bằng đá, và ông chết. Vua Rô-bô-am vội vàng lên xe để trốn [về] Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Rô-bô-am sai A-đô-ram, viên quan cai quản lao dịch, nhưng cả Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá ông chết. Vua Rô-bô-am vội vàng lên xe của mình và trốn về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Rồi vua Rô-bô-am sai A-đô-ram đến với dân chúng. A-đô-ram là người cai quản những người bị bắt làm việc nặng nhọc cho vua. Nhưng toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ném đá ông cho đến chết. Vua Rô-bô-am vội nhảy lên xe ngựa và chạy trốn về Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암 왕이 강제 노역을 맡은 아도람을 보냈으나, 온 이스라엘이 그를 돌로 쳤고 그가 죽었다. 그리고 르호보암 왕은 서둘러 병거에 올라 예루살렘으로 도망했다.
ko.B: 르호보암 왕이 강제 노역 감독관 아도람을 보냈지만, 온 이스라엘이 그를 돌로 쳐 죽였다. 르호보암 왕은 간신히 자기 병거에 올라 예루살렘으로 도망쳤다.
ko.R: 그러자 르호보암 왕은 아도람을 백성에게 보냈다. 아도람은 왕을 위해 억지로 일하는 사람들을 감독하는 관리였다. 그러나 이스라엘 백성은 그가 죽을 때까지 그에게 돌을 던졌다. 르호보암 왕은 서둘러 병거에 뛰어올라 예루살렘으로 도망쳤다.

pt.L: E o rei Roboão enviou Adorão, que [estava] sobre o trabalho forçado, e todo o Israel o apedrejou com pedras, e ele morreu. E o rei Roboão se apressou a subir no carro para fugir [para] Jerusalém.
pt.B: Então o rei Roboão enviou Adorão, o encarregado do trabalho forçado, mas todo o Israel o matou a pedradas. O rei Roboão conseguiu subir no seu carro e fugir para Jerusalém.
pt.R: Então o rei Roboão mandou Adorão falar com o povo. Adorão chefiava os homens obrigados a trabalhar para o rei. Mas todo o povo de Israel jogou pedras nele até ele morrer. O rei Roboão saltou depressa no seu carro e fugiu para Jerusalém.

am.L: ንጉሡ ሮብዓምም በግዳጅ ሥራ ላይ የነበረውን አዶራምን ላከ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በድንጋይ ወገሩት፤ ሞተም። ንጉሡ ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይሸሽ ዘንድ ወደ ሰረገላው ለመውጣት ቸኮለ።
am.B: ከዚያም ንጉሡ ሮብዓም በግዳጅ ሥራ ላይ የተሾመውን አዶራምን ላከ፤ እስራኤል ሁሉ ግን በድንጋይ ወግረው ገደሉት። ንጉሡ ሮብዓም ግን በጭንቅ ሰረገላው ላይ ወጥቶ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመለጠ።
am.R: ከዚያም ንጉሡ ሮብዓም አዶራምን ወደ ሕዝቡ ላከው። አዶራም ለንጉሡ በግድ እንዲሠሩ በተደረጉት ሰዎች ላይ ኃላፊ ነበረ። የእስራኤል ሕዝብ ሁሉ ግን እስኪሞት ድረስ በድንጋይ ወገሩት። ንጉሡ ሮብዓም ቸኩሎ ሰረገላው ላይ ዘሎ ወጣና ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም አመለጠ።

hi.L: और राजा रहबाम ने अदोराम को, जो बेगार पर [था], भेजा, और सारे इस्राएल ने उस पर पत्थर फेंककर उसे पत्थरवाह किया, और वह मर गया। और राजा रहबाम ने फुर्ती से रथ पर चढ़कर यरूशलेम को भाग गया।
hi.B: तब राजा रहबाम ने बेगार के अधिकारी अदोराम को भेजा, पर सारे इस्राएल ने उसे पत्थरवाह करके मार डाला। राजा रहबाम किसी तरह अपने रथ पर चढ़कर यरूशलेम को भाग निकला।
hi.R: तब राजा रहबाम ने अदोराम को लोगों के पास भेजा। अदोराम उन लोगों का अधिकारी था जिनसे राजा के लिए ज़बरदस्ती काम करवाया जाता था। पर इस्राएल के सब लोगों ने उस पर पत्थर बरसाए, यहाँ तक कि वह मर गया। राजा रहबाम जल्दी से अपने रथ पर कूदकर चढ़ा और यरूशलेम को भाग गया।

ru.L: И послал царь Ровоам Адорама, который [был] над подневольными работами, и весь Израиль побил его камнями, и он умер. А царь Ровоам поспешил взойти на колесницу, чтобы бежать в Иерусалим.
ru.B: Тогда царь Ровоам послал Адорама, начальника подневольных работ, но весь Израиль забросал его камнями насмерть. Царь Ровоам едва успел вскочить на свою колесницу и бежать в Иерусалим.
ru.R: Тогда царь Ровоам послал к народу Адорама. Адорам был начальником над людьми, которых заставляли работать на царя. Но израильтяне бросали в него камни, пока он не умер. Царь Ровоам поспешно вскочил на колесницу и убежал в Иерусалим.

ja.L: そしてレハブアム王は強制労働の監督であるアドラムを遣わしたが、全イスラエルは彼を石で打ち、彼は死んだ。そこでレハブアム王は急いで戦車に乗り、エルサレムへ逃げた。
ja.B: レハブアム王は、強制労働の監督であったアドラムを遣わしたが、全イスラエルは彼を石で打ち殺した。レハブアム王は、やっとのことで戦車に乗り込み、エルサレムへ逃げ帰った。
ja.R: それから、レハブアム王は、アドラムを人々のところに送りました。アドラムは、王のためにむりやり働かされている人たちの監督でした。ところが、イスラエルの人々はみな、アドラムに石を投げつけて殺してしまいました。レハブアム王は、急いで戦車に飛び乗り、エルサレムへ逃げました。

uk.L: І послав цар Ровоам Адорама, який [був] над примусовою працею, а весь Ізраїль закидав його камінням, і він помер. А цар Ровоам поспішив сісти на колісницю, щоб утекти [до] Єрусалима.
uk.B: Тоді цар Ровоам послав Адорама, начальника над примусовою працею, але весь Ізраїль закидав його камінням на смерть. Цар Ровоам ледве встиг сісти на свою колісницю й утекти до Єрусалима.
uk.R: Тоді цар Ровоам послав до народу Адорама. Адорам був начальником над людьми, яких примушували працювати на царя. Але всі ізраїльтяни кидали в нього камінням, аж поки він не помер. Цар Ровоам поспіхом скочив на свою колісницю і втік до Єрусалима.

decisions.choice: Adoram, over the forced labor
decisions.reason: The forced labor was the system of work gangs that built Solomon's temple, palace and cities (5:27-28; 9:15). Adoram is probably the same man as Adoniram, who held this post under Solomon (4:6; 5:28); the shorter form of his name is used in 2 Samuel 20:24. Sending the man in charge of the very burden the people complained of was a provocation, whatever Rehoboam meant by it.

decisions.choice: made haste: managed with effort
decisions.reason: The verb means to make oneself strong. Here it describes the king pulling himself together and getting into his chariot just in time; it was a narrow escape.

decisions.choice: stoned him: put him to death as a group
decisions.reason: Stoning was a death carried out by a whole community. Here it shows that the people as a body rejected the king's authority.

decisions.choice: the men who were forced to work for the king
decisions.reason: Readable explains what "the forced labor" was.

decisions.choice: his chariot
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the chariot"; it was the king's own.

decisions.choice: "Adoram"; "el trabajo forzado"
decisions.reason: Adoram keeps the form of the Spanish 2 Samuel 20:24; the forced labor is named as in that verse's office.

decisions.choice: "la corvée"
decisions.reason: "La corvée" is the French word for unpaid work required by a ruler; Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: gari (Literal "garini"); gari lake (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The king's chariot is simply "gari" here; "magari ya vita" is kept for chariots in battle.

decisions.choice: "lao dịch" for the forced labor
decisions.reason: "lao dịch" is the standard word for labor the state forces on its people; Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: Adorão; o trabalho forçado (L, B); os homens obrigados a trabalhar para o rei (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here has the short form of the name (m1), so Portuguese writes "Adorão", the form of 2 Samuel 20:24 in Portuguese, as the English writes "Adoram"; he is probably the "Adonirão" of 4:6. The office keeps the words of 4:6 at each level.

decisions.choice: "አዶራም" and "በግዳጅ ሥራ ላይ" as in the Amharic 2 Samuel 20:24
decisions.reason: The same officer and the same office.

decisions.choice: "अदोराम"; "बेगार"
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 20:24 in this translation; Readable explains forced labor with the words used there.

decisions.choice: "फुर्ती से रथ पर चढ़कर ... भाग गया" (L)
decisions.reason: Hindi joins "made haste to go up" into one clause with a conjunctive participle; nothing is lost.

decisions.choice: "Адорам"; "подневольные работы"
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 20:24 in this translation, the same man and office.

decisions.choice: Adoram "アドラム" (as 2SA 20:24, 2SA-4); 'al hammas "強制労働の監督" (L, B), R as a clause
decisions.reason: The same officer and the same form as in 2 Samuel; mas 強制労働 as 9:15.

source.text: וַיִּפְשְׁע֤וּ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּבֵ֣ית דָּוִ֔ד עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And rebelled Israel against [the] house of David until the day the this.

en.L: So Israel has rebelled against the house of David to this day.
en.B: So Israel has been in rebellion against the house of David to this day.
en.R: So Israel turned against the family of David, and it has stayed separate from it to this day.

es.L: Así se rebeló Israel contra la casa de David hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: Así Israel ha estado en rebelión contra la casa de David hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: Así Israel se rebeló contra la familia de David, y se ha mantenido separado de ella hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: Ainsi Israël s’est révolté contre la maison de David jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: Ainsi Israël est en révolte contre la maison de David jusqu’à aujourd’hui.
fr.R: Ainsi Israël s’est séparé de la famille de David, et il en est resté séparé jusqu’à aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Hivyo Israeli wameiasi nyumba ya Daudi mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Hivyo Israeli wamekuwa katika uasi dhidi ya nyumba ya Daudi mpaka leo.
sw.R: Hivyo Israeli waliigeuka jamaa ya Daudi, nao wamebaki wakiwa mbali nayo mpaka leo.

vi.L: Thế là Y-sơ-ra-ên phản nghịch nhà Đa-vít cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Thế là Y-sơ-ra-ên chống lại nhà Đa-vít cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Thế là Y-sơ-ra-ên quay lưng chống lại dòng dõi Đa-vít và tách riêng ra cho đến ngày nay.

ko.L: 그리하여 이스라엘이 다윗의 집을 배반하여 오늘날까지 [이르렀다].
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 이스라엘은 다윗 집안을 배반하여 오늘날까지 이르렀다.
ko.R: 이렇게 이스라엘은 다윗의 집안에 등을 돌렸고, 오늘날까지 다윗의 집안과 갈라져 있다.

pt.L: Assim Israel se rebelou contra a casa de Davi até o dia de hoje.
pt.B: Assim Israel tem estado em rebelião contra a casa de Davi até o dia de hoje.
pt.R: Assim Israel se voltou contra a família de Davi e continua separado dela até o dia de hoje.

am.L: እንዲሁ እስራኤል በዳዊት ቤት ላይ ዐመፀ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ [እንዲሁ ነው]።
am.B: ስለዚህ እስራኤል በዳዊት ቤት ላይ ዐመፀ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ እንዳመፀ ነው።
am.R: በዚህ ሁኔታ እስራኤል ከዳዊት ቤተሰብ ተገነጠለ፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ተለይቶ ይኖራል።

hi.L: इस प्रकार इस्राएल आज के दिन तक दाऊद के घराने से फिरा हुआ है।
hi.B: इस प्रकार इस्राएल आज तक दाऊद के घराने के विरुद्ध विद्रोह किए हुए है।
hi.R: इस प्रकार इस्राएल दाऊद के परिवार के विरुद्ध हो गया, और आज तक उससे अलग है।

ru.L: И отпал Израиль от дома Давида до этого дня.
ru.B: Так Израиль отделился от дома Давида и остаётся в отделении по сей день.
ru.R: Так Израиль восстал против семьи Давида и до сих пор живёт отдельно от неё.

ja.L: こうしてイスラエルは、今日に至るまでダビデの家に背いている。
ja.B: こうしてイスラエルは、今日に至るまでダビデの家に背いている。
ja.R: こうして、イスラエルはダビデの家族に逆らって離れ、今でも別の国のままです。

uk.L: Так Ізраїль відпав від дому Давида аж до цього дня.
uk.B: Так Ізраїль повстав проти дому Давида і є відступником аж до цього дня.
uk.R: Так Ізраїль повстав проти родини Давида і живе окремо від неї аж до сьогодні.

decisions.choice: rebelled: broke away from its ruler
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a people throwing off the rule of its overlord, as Moab and Edom later rebelled against Israel and Judah (2 Kings 1:1; 8:20). It describes a political break, not only a quarrel.

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own day
decisions.reason: As at 8:8, "to this day" means the time when this account was written. The northern kingdom never returned to the house of David.

decisions.choice: the house of David: the royal line promised to David
decisions.reason: The LORD had promised David a lasting house, a line of kings (2 Samuel 7:16). The split leaves that line ruling Judah only, as the LORD had said (11:13, 36).

decisions.choice: turned against ... stayed separate
decisions.reason: Readable puts the lasting state that the Hebrew verb describes in two plain verbs.

decisions.choice: "hasta el día de hoy"
decisions.reason: The Kings and Chronicles note's one wording for the writer's "to this day" at every level.

decisions.choice: "jusqu’à ce jour" (L); "jusqu’à aujourd’hui" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Kings and Chronicles terms note for the writer’s "to this day"; the passé composé of "s’est révolté" keeps the lasting result.

decisions.choice: mpaka siku hii ya leo (Literal); mpaka leo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The writer's "to this day" is settled for these books as "mpaka siku hii ya leo" at Literal and "mpaka leo" at Balanced and Readable; it is the writer's own day, as the meaning decision says.

decisions.choice: "cho đến ngày nay" for "to this day"
decisions.reason: The terms note's one wording for the writer's own day, at every level.

decisions.choice: "फिरा हुआ है" (L); "विद्रोह किए हुए है" (B); "के विरुद्ध हो गया ... अलग है" (R)
decisions.reason: Israel broke away from its ruler and stays so to the writer's day (meanings m1, m2).

decisions.choice: "до этого дня" (L); "по сей день" (B); "до сих пор" (R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 2-6 in Russian; the writer's own day (m2).

decisions.choice: pasha' "背いている" (L, B), "逆らって離れ" (R); beit david "ダビデの家" (L, B), "ダビデの家族" (R)
decisions.reason: marad / pasha' 背く (L, B), 逆らう (R) as JOS-consistency; house of David as 2SA 3:1.

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כִּֽי־שָׁ֣ב יָרָבְעָ֔ם וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֗וּ וַיִּקְרְא֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּמְלִ֥יכוּ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹ֤א הָיָה֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בֵית־דָּוִ֔ד זוּלָתִ֥י שֵֽׁבֶט־יְהוּדָ֖ה לְבַדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when heard all Israel that had returned Jeroboam, and they sent and called him to the congregation and made king him over all Israel; not was [one] after [the] house of David except [the] tribe of Judah by itself.

en.L: And it happened, when all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, that they sent and called him to the congregation and made him king over all Israel. There was none following the house of David except the tribe of Judah by itself.
en.B: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had returned, they sent for him, summoned him before the congregation, and made him king over all Israel. No one followed the house of David except the tribe of Judah alone.
en.R: When all Israel heard that Jeroboam had come back, they sent for him and called him to their gathering. There they made him king over all Israel. Only the tribe of Judah stayed loyal to David's family.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando oyó todo Israel que Jeroboam había vuelto, enviaron y lo llamaron a la congregación, y lo hicieron rey sobre todo Israel. No hubo quien siguiera a la casa de David, sino solo la tribu de Judá.
es.B: Cuando todo Israel oyó que Jeroboam había vuelto, mandaron a buscarlo, lo convocaron ante la asamblea y lo proclamaron rey sobre todo Israel. Nadie siguió a la casa de David, excepto la tribu de Judá sola.
es.R: Cuando todo Israel oyó que Jeroboam había regresado, mandaron a buscarlo y lo llamaron a su reunión. Allí lo hicieron rey sobre todo Israel. Solo la tribu de Judá siguió siendo leal a la familia de David.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand tout Israël apprit que Jéroboam était revenu, qu’ils envoyèrent [quelqu’un] et l’appelèrent à l’assemblée, et ils le firent roi sur tout Israël. Il n’y eut personne à la suite de la maison de David, excepté la tribu de Juda seule.
fr.B: Quand tout Israël apprit que Jéroboam était revenu, on l’envoya chercher, on le convoqua devant l’assemblée et on le fit roi sur tout Israël. Personne ne suivit la maison de David, sauf la seule tribu de Juda.
fr.R: Quand tout Israël a appris que Jéroboam était revenu, on l’a envoyé chercher et on l’a appelé au rassemblement. Là, on l’a fait roi sur tout Israël. Seule la tribu de Juda est restée fidèle à la famille de David.

sw.L: Ikawa, Israeli wote waliposikia kwamba Yeroboamu amerudi, wakatuma wakamwita aje kwenye mkutano, wakamfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote. Hakuna aliyeifuata nyumba ya Daudi isipokuwa kabila la Yuda peke yake.
sw.B: Israeli wote waliposikia kwamba Yeroboamu amerudi, walituma watu kumwita mbele ya mkutano, wakamfanya mfalme juu ya Israeli wote. Hakuna aliyeifuata nyumba ya Daudi isipokuwa kabila la Yuda peke yake.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Israeli waliposikia kwamba Yeroboamu amerudi, walituma watu kumwita aje kwenye mkutano wao. Huko wakamfanya kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli wote. Kabila la Yuda peke yake ndilo lililobaki mwaminifu kwa jamaa ya Daudi.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi cả Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe rằng Giê-rô-bô-am đã trở về, thì họ sai [người] mời ông đến hội chúng và lập ông làm vua trên cả Y-sơ-ra-ên. Không có ai theo nhà Đa-vít, ngoại trừ một mình chi tộc Giu-đa.
vi.B: Khi cả Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe tin Giê-rô-bô-am đã trở về, họ sai người mời ông đến trước hội chúng và lập ông làm vua cả Y-sơ-ra-ên. Không ai theo nhà Đa-vít, chỉ trừ một mình chi tộc Giu-đa.
vi.R: Khi cả Y-sơ-ra-ên nghe tin Giê-rô-bô-am đã trở về, họ sai người mời ông đến buổi họp của họ. Tại đó họ lập ông làm vua cả Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chỉ có chi tộc Giu-đa là còn trung thành với dòng dõi Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘이 여로보암이 돌아왔다는 것을 들었을 때, 그들이 사람을 보내어 그를 회중에게로 불러 그를 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다. 유다 지파 하나밖에는 다윗의 집을 따르는 자가 없었다.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘은 여로보암이 돌아왔다는 소식을 듣고 사람을 보내 그를 회중 앞으로 불렀다. 그리고 그를 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다. 유다 지파 말고는 다윗 집안을 따르는 지파가 하나도 없었다.
ko.R: 온 이스라엘은 여로보암이 돌아왔다는 소식을 듣고, 사람을 보내 그를 자기들의 모임에 불렀다. 그리고 거기에서 그를 온 이스라엘의 왕으로 세웠다. 유다 지파만이 다윗의 집안에 충성을 지켰다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando todo o Israel ouviu que Jeroboão tinha voltado, mandaram chamá-lo à comunidade e o fizeram rei sobre todo o Israel. Não houve ninguém que seguisse a casa de Davi, a não ser só a tribo de Judá.
pt.B: Quando todo o Israel ouviu que Jeroboão tinha voltado, mandaram chamá-lo diante da comunidade e o fizeram rei sobre todo o Israel. Ninguém seguiu a casa de Davi, a não ser a tribo de Judá.
pt.R: Quando todo o Israel ouviu que Jeroboão tinha voltado, mandaram chamá-lo para a reunião do povo. Ali o fizeram rei sobre todo o Israel. Só a tribo de Judá continuou fiel à família de Davi.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ እስራኤል ሁሉ ኢዮርብዓም እንደ ተመለሰ በሰሙ ጊዜ ልከው ወደ ማኅበሩ ጠሩት፤ በእስራኤልም ሁሉ ላይ አነገሡት። ከይሁዳ ነገድ ብቻ በቀር የዳዊትን ቤት የተከተለ አልነበረም።
am.B: እስራኤል ሁሉ ኢዮርብዓም መመለሱን በሰሙ ጊዜ ልከው ወደ ማኅበሩ አስጠሩት፤ በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይም አነገሡት። ከይሁዳ ነገድ ብቻ በቀር የዳዊትን ቤት የተከተለ ማንም አልነበረም።
am.R: እስራኤል ሁሉ ኢዮርብዓም መመለሱን በሰሙ ጊዜ ሰው ልከው ወደ ጉባኤአቸው ጠሩት። በዚያም በእስራኤል ሁሉ ላይ አነገሡት። ለዳዊት ቤተሰብ ታማኝ ሆኖ የቀረው የይሁዳ ነገድ ብቻ ነበረ።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब सारे इस्राएल ने सुना कि यारोबाम लौट आया है, तब उन्होंने भेजकर उसे मंडली में बुलवाया और उसे सारे इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया। केवल यहूदा के गोत्र को छोड़ कोई दाऊद के घराने के पीछे न रहा।
hi.B: जब सारे इस्राएल ने सुना कि यारोबाम लौट आया है, तब उन्होंने उसे बुलवाकर मंडली के सामने बुलाया और सारे इस्राएल पर राजा बनाया। केवल यहूदा के गोत्र को छोड़ कोई दाऊद के घराने के पीछे न चला।
hi.R: जब इस्राएल के सब लोगों ने सुना कि यारोबाम लौट आया है, तब उन्होंने उसे बुलवाकर अपनी सभा में बुलाया। वहाँ उन्होंने उसे सारे इस्राएल का राजा बनाया। केवल यहूदा का गोत्र दाऊद के परिवार के प्रति वफ़ादार रहा।

ru.L: И было, когда услышал весь Израиль, что вернулся Иеровоам, они послали, и позвали его в общину, и поставили его царём над всем Израилем. Не было [никого], кто следовал за домом Давида, кроме одного колена Иуды.
ru.B: Когда весь Израиль услышал, что Иеровоам вернулся, за ним послали, позвали его в общину и поставили царём над всем Израилем. За домом Давида не пошёл никто, кроме одного колена Иуды.
ru.R: Когда весь Израиль услышал, что Иеровоам вернулся, за ним послали и позвали его на собрание народа. Там его сделали царём над всем Израилем. Только племя Иуды осталось верным семье Давида.

ja.L: そして、全イスラエルがヤロブアムが戻ったことを聞いたとき、彼らは人を遣わして彼を会衆のもとに呼び、彼を全イスラエルの上に王とした。ユダの部族だけのほかには、ダビデの家に従う者はなかった。
ja.B: 全イスラエルは、ヤロブアムが帰って来たことを聞くと、使いを送って彼を共同体の集まりに呼び、全イスラエルの王とした。ダビデの家に従ったのは、ユダの部族だけであった。
ja.R: イスラエルの人々はみな、ヤロブアムが帰って来たと聞くと、使いを送って、自分たちの集まりにヤロブアムを呼びました。そして、そこでヤロブアムを全イスラエルの王にしました。ダビデの家族に忠実なままだったのは、ユダの部族だけでした。

uk.L: І сталося, коли почув увесь Ізраїль, що Єровоам повернувся, то послали вони, і покликали його до громади, і настановили його царем над усім Ізраїлем. Не було [нікого], хто йшов би за домом Давида, крім самого племені Юди.
uk.B: Коли весь Ізраїль почув, що Єровоам повернувся, вони послали по нього, покликали його перед громаду і настановили його царем над усім Ізраїлем. Ніхто не пішов за домом Давида, крім одного племені Юди.
uk.R: Коли весь Ізраїль почув, що Єровоам повернувся, вони послали по нього і покликали його на своє зібрання. Там вони зробили його царем над усім Ізраїлем. Тільки племʼя Юди лишилося вірним родині Давида.

decisions.choice: Israel: from here on, the northern kingdom; Judah: the southern kingdom
decisions.reason: Until now "Israel" has named the whole people and the kingdom of David and Solomon. From this verse on, Kings uses "Israel" for the kingdom of the northern tribes ruled by Jeroboam and his successors, and "Judah" for the kingdom ruled by David's line from Jerusalem. The wider sense still appears in some phrases, such as "the LORD, the God of Israel".

decisions.choice: Jeroboam had returned: the northern assembly's side of the story
decisions.reason: Verses 3 and 12 already have Jeroboam with the people at Shechem. This verse may tell how the tribes, once Rehoboam had been rejected, formally called Jeroboam to their assembly and made him king. See the note at verse 3.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Judah alone: Benjamin was also joined to Judah
decisions.reason: The next verse counts Benjamin with Judah. The prophet had said that one tribe would be left to David's line (11:13, 32, 36); Judah was that tribe, and part of Benjamin, where Jerusalem lay on the border, stayed with it.

decisions.choice: the congregation: the tribes formally assembled
decisions.reason: The word names Israel gathered as a body to act together. Here the assembly of the northern tribes makes Jeroboam king.

decisions.choice: Israel and Judah at every level
decisions.reason: The names are kept as the Hebrew has them at every level, without "the northern kingdom" or "the southern kingdom"; the meaning decision explains them. Readable says "gathering" for the congregation, as the Numbers to Ruth terms allow.

decisions.choice: "la congregación" (L); "la asamblea" (B); "su reunión" (R)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's words for *ʿedah*: comunidad or congregación at Literal; Balanced and Readable say what the gathering was, the assembled tribes.

decisions.choice: Israeli and Yuda at every level
decisions.reason: From here on "Israeli" names the northern kingdom and "Yuda" the southern one, at every level, as the English does; Readable does not add "kaskazini" or "kusini" each time.

decisions.choice: a comunidade (L, B); a reunião do povo (R)
decisions.reason: The word for the congregation (m4) is "a comunidade", as the Old Testament terms keep it apart from "a assembleia" of verse 3; Readable says "a reunião do povo" for both, as the English says "gathering".

decisions.choice: "इस्राएल" and "यहूदा" at every level
decisions.reason: From here on "Israel" is the northern kingdom and "Judah" the southern (meaning m1); Hindi keeps the two names as the Hebrew has them, as the English does.
The congregation (ʿedah) as the Pentateuch note's "मंडली", kept apart from the assembly (qahal) of verse 3; Readable says "सभा" (gathering).

decisions.choice: "Израиль" for the northern kingdom, "Иуда" for the southern
decisions.reason: From here on "Израиль" names the northern kingdom and "Иуда" the southern (m1), at every level, with no added "Северное царство".

decisions.choice: "община" (L, B); "собрание народа" (R)
decisions.reason: 'Edah, the tribes formally assembled (m4), is "община", as the Pentateuch note sets.

decisions.choice: 'edah "会衆" (L), "共同体の集まり" (B), "自分たちの集まり" (R); Israel / Judah as the names of the two kingdoms from here on
decisions.reason: edah 会衆 (L), 共同体 (B, R) as NUM-consistency. From here "Israel" is the northern kingdom and "Judah" the southern, at every level, as the English.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א רְחַבְעָם֮ יְרוּשָׁלִַם֒ וַיַּקְהֵל֩ אֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֨ית יְהוּדָ֜ה וְאֶת־שֵׁ֣בֶט בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מֵאָ֨ה וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף בָּח֖וּר עֹשֵׂ֣ה מִלְחָמָ֑ה לְהִלָּחֵם֙ עִם־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְהָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה לִרְחַבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And came Rehoboam [to] Jerusalem, and he assembled all [the] house of Judah and [the] tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen [men], doers of war, to fight with [the] house of Israel, to bring back the kingship to Rehoboam son of Solomon.

en.L: And Rehoboam came [to] Jerusalem and assembled all the house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 chosen [men], makers of war, to fight with the house of Israel, to bring back the kingdom to Rehoboam son of Solomon.
en.B: When Rehoboam arrived in Jerusalem, he mustered the whole house of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, 180,000 picked warriors, to fight against the house of Israel and regain the kingdom for Rehoboam son of Solomon.
en.R: When Rehoboam got back to Jerusalem, he gathered 180,000 of the best soldiers from all the people of Judah and from the tribe of Benjamin. He wanted to fight against Israel and win back the kingdom for himself, Rehoboam son of Solomon.

es.L: Y llegó Roboam [a] Jerusalén y reunió a toda la casa de Judá y a la tribu de Benjamín, 180 000 [hombres] escogidos, hacedores de guerra, para pelear contra la casa de Israel, para devolver el reino a Roboam hijo de Salomón.
es.B: Cuando Roboam llegó a Jerusalén, convocó a toda la casa de Judá y a la tribu de Benjamín, 180 000 guerreros escogidos, para pelear contra la casa de Israel y recuperar el reino para Roboam hijo de Salomón.
es.R: Cuando Roboam volvió a Jerusalén, reunió a 180 000 de los mejores soldados de todo el pueblo de Judá y de la tribu de Benjamín. Quería pelear contra Israel y recuperar el reino para sí mismo, Roboam hijo de Salomón.

fr.L: Et Roboam vint [à] Jérusalem, et il rassembla toute la maison de Juda et la tribu de Benjamin, 180 000 [hommes] choisis, faiseurs de guerre, pour combattre contre la maison d’Israël, pour ramener la royauté à Roboam fils de Salomon.
fr.B: Arrivé à Jérusalem, Roboam rassembla toute la maison de Juda et la tribu de Benjamin, 180 000 guerriers d’élite, pour combattre la maison d’Israël et reconquérir le royaume pour Roboam, fils de Salomon.
fr.R: Quand Roboam est arrivé à Jérusalem, il a rassemblé 180 000 des meilleurs soldats de tout le peuple de Juda et de la tribu de Benjamin. Il voulait faire la guerre à Israël et reprendre le royaume pour lui-même, Roboam, fils de Salomon.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akafika Yerusalemu, akaikusanya nyumba yote ya Yuda na kabila la Benyamini, [watu] 180,000 waliochaguliwa, watendaji wa vita, ili kupigana na nyumba ya Israeli, kuurudisha ufalme kwa Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alipofika Yerusalemu, aliikusanya nyumba yote ya Yuda na kabila la Benyamini, wapiganaji hodari 180,000 waliochaguliwa, ili kupigana na nyumba ya Israeli na kumrudishia Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani ufalme.
sw.R: Rehoboamu aliporudi Yerusalemu, aliwakusanya askari bora 180,000 kutoka kwa watu wote wa Yuda na kutoka kabila la Benyamini. Alitaka kupigana na Israeli na kuurudisha ufalme kwake mwenyewe, yeye Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, tập hợp cả nhà Giu-đa và chi tộc Bên-gia-min, một trăm tám mươi ngàn [người] tuyển chọn, là những người thạo việc chiến trận, để giao chiến với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, để đem vương quốc trở về cho Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn.
vi.B: Khi về đến Giê-ru-sa-lem, Rô-bô-am triệu tập cả nhà Giu-đa và chi tộc Bên-gia-min, được 180.000 chiến binh tinh nhuệ, để đánh nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và giành lại vương quốc cho Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn.
vi.R: Khi về tới Giê-ru-sa-lem, Rô-bô-am tập hợp 180.000 binh sĩ giỏi nhất từ toàn dân Giu-đa và chi tộc Bên-gia-min. Ông muốn đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên để giành lại vương quốc cho chính mình, là Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 예루살렘에 와서 유다의 온 집과 베냐민 지파, 곧 전쟁을 하는 자들 가운데 뽑힌 [자] 18만 명을 모아, 이스라엘의 집과 싸워 나라를 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암에게 되돌리려 했다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 예루살렘에 돌아오자 유다 온 집안과 베냐민 지파에서 뽑힌 용사 18만 명을 불러 모았다. 이스라엘 집안과 싸워서 나라를 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암에게 되찾아 오려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 예루살렘에 돌아오자, 유다의 모든 백성과 베냐민 지파에서 가장 뛰어난 군인 18만 명을 모았다. 그는 이스라엘과 싸워서 나라를 다시 자기 것으로, 곧 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암의 것으로 되찾으려고 했다.

pt.L: E Roboão veio [a] Jerusalém e reuniu toda a casa de Judá e a tribo de Benjamim, cento e oitenta mil [homens] escolhidos, guerreiros, para lutar contra a casa de Israel, para devolver o reino a Roboão, filho de Salomão.
pt.B: Quando chegou a Jerusalém, Roboão convocou toda a casa de Judá e a tribo de Benjamim, cento e oitenta mil guerreiros escolhidos, para lutar contra a casa de Israel e recuperar o reino para Roboão, filho de Salomão.
pt.R: Quando voltou a Jerusalém, Roboão reuniu cento e oitenta mil dos melhores soldados de todo o povo de Judá e da tribo de Benjamim. Ele queria lutar contra Israel e reconquistar o reino para si mesmo, Roboão, filho de Salomão.

am.L: ሮብዓምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ ከእስራኤልም ቤት ጋር ይዋጉ ዘንድ፣ መንግሥቱንም ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም ይመልሱ ዘንድ የይሁዳን ቤት ሁሉና የብንያምን ነገድ፣ 180,000 የተመረጡ [ሰዎች]፣ ጦርነት አድራጊዎችን ሰበሰበ።
am.B: ሮብዓም ኢየሩሳሌም በደረሰ ጊዜ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር ተዋግቶ መንግሥቱን ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም ለማስመለስ የይሁዳን ቤት ሁሉና የብንያምን ነገድ፣ 180,000 የተመረጡ ጦረኞችን ሰበሰበ።
am.R: ሮብዓም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በተመለሰ ጊዜ ከይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉና ከብንያም ነገድ 180,000 ምርጥ ወታደሮችን ሰበሰበ። ከእስራኤል ጋር ተዋግቶ መንግሥቱን ለራሱ፣ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም፣ መልሶ ሊወስድ ፈለገ።

hi.L: और रहबाम यरूशलेम को आया, और उसने यहूदा के सारे घराने और बिन्यामीन के गोत्र को, 1,80,000 चुने हुए [पुरुषों] को, जो युद्ध करनेवाले थे, इकट्ठा किया, कि इस्राएल के घराने से लड़कर राज्य को सुलैमान के पुत्र रहबाम के पास लौटा लाएँ।
hi.B: जब रहबाम यरूशलेम पहुँचा, तब उसने यहूदा के सारे घराने और बिन्यामीन के गोत्र में से 1,80,000 चुने हुए योद्धा इकट्ठे किए, ताकि वे इस्राएल के घराने से लड़कर सुलैमान के पुत्र रहबाम के लिए राज्य फिर से प्राप्त करें।
hi.R: जब रहबाम यरूशलेम लौटा, तब उसने यहूदा के सब लोगों में से और बिन्यामीन के गोत्र में से 1,80,000 सबसे अच्छे सैनिक इकट्ठे किए। वह इस्राएल से लड़कर राज्य अपने लिए, यानी सुलैमान के पुत्र रहबाम के लिए, वापस लेना चाहता था।

ru.L: И пришёл Ровоам в Иерусалим и собрал весь дом Иуды и колено Вениамина, сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных [воинов], делающих войну, чтобы сразиться с домом Израиля, чтобы вернуть царство Ровоаму, сыну Соломона.
ru.B: Когда Ровоам прибыл в Иерусалим, он собрал весь дом Иуды и колено Вениамина — сто восемьдесят тысяч отборных воинов, — чтобы воевать с домом Израиля и вернуть царство Ровоаму, сыну Соломона.
ru.R: Когда Ровоам вернулся в Иерусалим, он собрал сто восемьдесят тысяч лучших воинов из всего народа Иуды и из племени Вениамина. Он хотел воевать с Израилем и вернуть царство себе, Ровоаму, сыну Соломона.

ja.L: そしてレハブアムはエルサレムに来て、ユダの全家とベニヤミンの部族、選り抜きの戦士十八万を集め、イスラエルの家と戦って、王国をソロモンの子レハブアムに取り戻そうとした。
ja.B: レハブアムはエルサレムに着くと、ユダの全家とベニヤミンの部族から、選り抜きの戦士十八万を召集した。イスラエルの家と戦って、ソロモンの子レハブアムのために王国を取り戻すためである。
ja.R: レハブアムは、エルサレムに帰ると、ユダの人々とベニヤミンの部族から、えりすぐりの兵士十八万人を集めました。イスラエルと戦って、ソロモンの息子である自分、レハブアムのために、王国を取り戻そうとしたのです。

uk.L: І прийшов Ровоам [до] Єрусалима, і зібрав увесь дім Юди і племʼя Веніямина, 180 000 добірних [мужів], вояків, щоб воювати з домом Ізраїля, щоб повернути царство Ровоамові, синові Соломона.
uk.B: Коли Ровоам прибув до Єрусалима, він скликав увесь дім Юди і племʼя Веніямина, 180 000 добірних воїнів, щоб воювати проти дому Ізраїля і повернути царство Ровоамові, синові Соломона.
uk.R: Коли Ровоам повернувся до Єрусалима, він зібрав 180 000 найкращих воїнів з усього народу Юди і з племені Веніямина. Він хотів воювати проти Ізраїлю і повернути царство собі, Ровоамові, синові Соломона.

decisions.choice: the tribe of Benjamin with Judah
decisions.reason: Benjamin lay between Judah and the northern tribes, and Jerusalem stood on its border with Judah (Joshua 18:16, 28). Though Saul had come from Benjamin, at least part of the tribe now stayed with the house of David.

decisions.choice: 180,000: "thousand" as written
decisions.reason: The number is given as the Hebrew has it. As in the census lists of Numbers, the word for "thousand" can also name a military unit, which would make the force much smaller.

decisions.choice: chosen men, makers of war: picked fighting men
decisions.reason: "Chosen" means men picked for service, usually young and fit; "makers of war" means trained soldiers.

decisions.choice: came: the form marked to be read aloud is singular
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) spell the verb "came" differently; the marked form is singular, agreeing with Rehoboam. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: for himself, Rehoboam son of Solomon
decisions.reason: Readable splits the long sentence and makes clear that Rehoboam meant to win back the kingdom for himself.

decisions.choice: "180 000" in figures
decisions.reason: Numbers above one hundred in figures, with a space for the thousands, as the Spanish of 2 Samuel and the Pentateuch note do.

decisions.choice: numbers above cent in figures with a space for thousands ("180 000")
decisions.reason: As the later Samuel blocks: numbers above a hundred in figures, French style, for the whole block.

decisions.choice: numbers: words at Literal, figures with a dot at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Large numbers are written in figures (1.700, 20.000), as in 2 Samuel; Literal spells out the Hebrew's "a hundred and eighty thousand" so its wording can be followed.

decisions.choice: the number in figures, "18만 명"
decisions.reason: As in the Samuel drafts, large numbers are written in figures at every level.

decisions.choice: cento e oitenta mil
decisions.reason: A round number, written in words as Portuguese does (style section 5; 2 Samuel in Portuguese), where the English writes numerals.
Figures in Indian digit grouping, as the Pentateuch note asks; the number as written (meaning m2).

decisions.choice: "बिन्यामीन"
decisions.reason: The form of Genesis and 2 Samuel in this translation.

decisions.choice: Benjamin "ベニヤミン"; bachur 'oseh milchamah "選り抜きの戦士" (L, B), "えりすぐりの兵士" (R)
decisions.reason: Picked fighting men; the number as written (十八万), as the English.

hi.R: पर परमेश्वर ने परमेश्वर के जन शमायाह को यह संदेश दिया:

ru.L: И было слово Божье к Шемаии, человеку Божьему, говоря:
ru.B: Но Шемаии, человеку Божьему, было слово Божье:
ru.R: Но Бог дал Шемаии, человеку Божьему, такую весть:

ja.L: そして神の言葉が神の人シェマヤに臨んで言った。
ja.B: しかし、神の言葉が神の人シェマヤに臨んだ。
ja.R: しかし、神は、神の人シェマヤに、こう告げられました。

uk.L: І було слово Бога до Шемаї, чоловіка Божого, кажучи:
uk.B: Але було слово Бога до Шемаї, чоловіка Божого:
uk.R: Але Бог дав таке послання Шемаї, чоловікові Божому:

decisions.choice: the man of God: a prophet
decisions.reason: "Man of God" is a title for a prophet who speaks God's word (1 Samuel 2:27; 9:6-10). Shemaiah appears again in 2 Chronicles 12:5-8, 15.

decisions.choice: but: God stops the war
decisions.reason: The word of God comes just as Rehoboam is ready to march, and it turns the story.

decisions.choice: "Semaías"; "el hombre de Dios"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form of Shemaiah; "el hombre de Dios" as the Kings and Chronicles terms table sets.

decisions.choice: "Shemaya"
decisions.reason: The usual French spelling with sh and y, as Benaya and Abiya in the terms note.

decisions.choice: neno la Mungu likamjia
decisions.reason: "The word came to X" is settled for these books as "neno la ... likamjia X".

decisions.choice: "người của Đức Chúa Trời" for "the man of God"
decisions.reason: The terms notes' form for this title of a prophet, at every level.

decisions.choice: "말씀이 ...에게 임하여 말씀하셨다" (L), "말씀이 ...에게 임했다" (B), "...께서 ...에게 말씀하셨다" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for "the word of the LORD came to X", used here with God; it holds through the block.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 사람" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the title at every level; the meaning decision says that it names a prophet.

decisions.choice: Semaías, o homem de Deus
decisions.reason: "Semaías" is the usual Brazilian form of the name; "o homem de Deus" is the prophet's title kept at every level, as 13:1 sets it for the book (m1).

decisions.choice: "የእግዚአብሔር ሰው" (the man of God); "ሸማያ" (Shemaiah)
decisions.reason: Ha-elohim here is the one God, so "እግዚአብሔር" with no divine_name span, which is kept for YHWH; "the man of God" is the phrase the terms list sets.

decisions.choice: "शमायाह"; "परमेश्वर का जन"
decisions.reason: Shemaiah transcribed; "the man of God" as the history-books note, at every level (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "Шемаия" (dat. "Шемаии")
decisions.reason: Transcribed from the Hebrew; the Synodal "Самей" would clash with Shimei, "Семей", in 2 Samuel 16 and 1 Kings 2.

decisions.choice: "человек Божий"
decisions.reason: As the history terms note sets for "the man of God".

decisions.choice: devar ha'elohim "神の言葉が…臨んだ" (L, B), R "神は…告げられました"; Shemaiah "シェマヤ"; ish ha'elohim "神の人"
decisions.reason: The word-came formula as 1SA 15:10 (1SA-3); man of God 神の人 as 1SA 2:27.

source.text: אֱמֹ֗ר אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־שְׁלֹמֹה֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־כָּל־בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבִנְיָמִ֑ין וְיֶ֥תֶר הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all [the] house of Judah and Benjamin and [the] rest of the people, saying,

en.L: "Say to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people, saying,
en.B: "Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to the whole house of Judah and Benjamin, and to everyone else among the people, and tell them,
en.R: "Speak to Rehoboam son of Solomon, the king of Judah. Speak also to all the people of Judah and Benjamin and to everyone else who is with them. Tell them,

es.L: «Di a Roboam hijo de Salomón, rey de Judá, y a toda la casa de Judá y Benjamín, y al resto del pueblo, diciendo:
es.B: «Habla a Roboam hijo de Salomón, rey de Judá, y a toda la casa de Judá y Benjamín, y a todos los demás del pueblo, y diles:
es.R: «Habla con Roboam hijo de Salomón, el rey de Judá. Habla también con todo el pueblo de Judá y de Benjamín, y con todos los demás que están con ellos. Diles:

fr.L: « Dis à Roboam fils de Salomon, roi de Juda, et à toute la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, et au reste du peuple, en disant :
fr.B: « Parle à Roboam, fils de Salomon, roi de Juda, à toute la maison de Juda et de Benjamin, et à tout le reste du peuple, et dis-leur :
fr.R: « Parle à Roboam, fils de Salomon, le roi de Juda. Parle aussi à tout le peuple de Juda et de Benjamin, et à tous ceux qui sont avec eux. Dis-leur :

sw.L: "Sema na Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani, mfalme wa Yuda, na nyumba yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, na watu wengine waliobaki, ukisema,
sw.B: "Mwambie Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani, mfalme wa Yuda, na nyumba yote ya Yuda na Benyamini, na watu wengine wote, uwaambie,
sw.R: "Sema na Rehoboamu mwana wa Sulemani, mfalme wa Yuda. Sema pia na watu wote wa Yuda na Benyamini, na wengine wote walio pamoja nao. Waambie,

vi.L: "Hãy nói với Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn, vua Giu-đa, và với cả nhà Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, và phần dân còn lại, rằng:
vi.B: "Hãy nói với Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn, vua Giu-đa, với cả nhà Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, và với mọi người khác trong dân chúng:
vi.R: "Hãy nói với Rô-bô-am con trai Sa-lô-môn, vua Giu-đa. Cũng hãy nói với toàn dân Giu-đa và Bên-gia-min, và với mọi người khác đang ở với họ. Hãy bảo họ:

ko.L: "유다 왕 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암과 유다와 베냐민의 온 집과 백성의 나머지에게 말하여 일러라.
ko.B: "유다 왕 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암과 유다와 베냐민 온 집안과 그 밖의 모든 백성에게 이렇게 전하여라.
ko.R: "유다 왕 솔로몬의 아들 르호보암에게 말하여라. 또 유다와 베냐민의 모든 백성과 그들과 함께 있는 다른 모든 사람에게도 말하여라. 그들에게 이렇게 전하여라.

pt.L: "Dize a Roboão, filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a toda a casa de Judá e Benjamim, e ao resto do povo, dizendo:
pt.B: "Fala a Roboão, filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a toda a casa de Judá e de Benjamim, e a todo o restante do povo, e dize-lhes:
pt.R: "Fala com Roboão, filho de Salomão, o rei de Judá. Fala também com todo o povo de Judá e de Benjamim e com todos os outros que estão com eles. Dize a eles:

am.L: «ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም፣ ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ቤት ሁሉ፣ ለቀረውም ሕዝብ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገር፦
am.B: «ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም፣ ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ቤት ሁሉ፣ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ለቀሩት ሁሉ ተናገር፤ እንዲህም በላቸው፦
am.R: «የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ለሆነው ለሰሎሞን ልጅ ለሮብዓም ተናገር። ደግሞም ለይሁዳና ለብንያም ሕዝብ ሁሉ፣ ከእነርሱም ጋር ላሉት ሁሉ ተናገር። እንዲህ በላቸው፦

hi.L: "सुलैमान के पुत्र यहूदा के राजा रहबाम से, और यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के सारे घराने से, और बाक़ी लोगों से कहो,
hi.B: "सुलैमान के पुत्र, यहूदा के राजा रहबाम से, और यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के सारे घराने से, और लोगों में से बाक़ी सब से बात करके कहो,
hi.R: "सुलैमान के पुत्र, यहूदा के राजा रहबाम से बात करो। यहूदा और बिन्यामीन के सब लोगों से और उनके साथ के बाक़ी सब लोगों से भी बात करो। उनसे कहो,

ru.L: «Скажи Ровоаму, сыну Соломона, царю Иуды, и всему дому Иуды и Вениамина, и остальному народу, говоря:
ru.B: «Скажи Ровоаму, сыну Соломона, царю Иуды, и всему дому Иуды и Вениамина, и всем остальным из народа:
ru.R: «Поговори с Ровоамом, сыном Соломона, царём Иуды. Поговори и со всем народом Иуды и Вениамина и со всеми, кто с ними. Скажи им:

ja.L: 「ユダの王、ソロモンの子レハブアムと、ユダとベニヤミンの全家と、残りの民に言いなさい。
ja.B: 「ユダの王、ソロモンの子レハブアムと、ユダとベニヤミンの全家と、そのほかの民すべてに、こう告げなさい。
ja.R: 「ユダの王である、ソロモンの息子レハブアムに言いなさい。ユダとベニヤミンのすべての人々と、一緒にいるほかの人たちにも、こう伝えなさい。

uk.L: «Скажи Ровоамові, синові Соломона, царю Юдеї, і всьому домові Юди і Веніямина, і решті народу, кажучи:
uk.B: «Скажи Ровоамові, синові Соломона, царю Юдеї, і всьому домові Юди і Веніямина, і всім іншим з народу, скажи їм:
uk.R: «Скажи Ровоамові, синові Соломона, царю Юдеї. Скажи також усім людям Юди і Веніямина і всім іншим, хто з ними. Скажи їм:

decisions.choice: king of Judah: God's word names Rehoboam king of Judah only
decisions.reason: For the first time Rehoboam is called "king of Judah". God's message itself accepts the division of the kingdom.

decisions.choice: the rest of the people: others gathered with Judah and Benjamin
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean people of other tribes who lived in Judah (verse 17), or simply everyone else in Rehoboam's army.

decisions.choice: Dize, Fala (God to Shemaiah)
decisions.reason: God speaks to his prophet with "tu", as he sends Nathan in 2 Samuel 7:5 in Portuguese ("Vai e dize"), at every level.

decisions.choice: God says "तुम" to Shemaiah ("कहो")
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note: God speaking to people says "तुम".

decisions.choice: God to Shemaiah plain (〜しなさい); the message inside 『 』 in the next record
decisions.reason: As God to his prophets in 1SA-2SA.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֡ה לֹֽא־תַעֲלוּ֩ וְלֹא־תִלָּ֨חֲמ֜וּן עִם־אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שׁ֚וּבוּ אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֔וֹ כִּ֧י מֵאִתִּ֛י נִהְיָ֖ה הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֥בוּ לָלֶ֖כֶת כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh, Not you shall go up and not you shall fight with your brothers, [the] sons of Israel; return each to his house, for from with me has come about the thing the this. And they listened to [the] word of Yahweh and turned back to go according to [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: 'Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: You shall not go up, and you shall not fight with your brothers, the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel. Return, each man to his house, for this thing has come about from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'" And they listened to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and turned back to go [home], according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: '{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Do not go up to fight against your relatives, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. Go home, every one of you, for this thing has come from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.'" So they heeded the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and went back home, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said.
en.R: 'This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do not go to war against your relatives, the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. All of you go home. I am the one who made this happen.'" So they obeyed the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and went home, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had told them.

es.L: “Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:subirán ni pelearán|subiréis ni pelearéis}} contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos, los hijos de Israel. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} cada uno a su casa, porque de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} ha venido esto”». Y escucharon la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se volvieron para irse [a casa], conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: “{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: No {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} a pelear contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes, los israelitas. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a casa cada uno, porque esto ha venido de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}”». Así que obedecieron la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y regresaron a casa, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho.
es.R: “Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: No {{plural_you:vayan|vayáis}} a la guerra contra {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} parientes, los israelitas. {{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} todos a casa. Yo soy quien hizo que esto sucediera”». Así que obedecieron la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y se fueron a casa, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les había dicho.

fr.L: “Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Vous ne monterez pas et vous ne combattrez pas contre vos frères, les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël. Retournez chacun dans sa maison, car c’est de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que cette chose est venue.” » Et ils écoutèrent la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils s’en retournèrent pour s’en aller selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: “{{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Ne montez pas combattre contre vos frères, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Rentrez chacun chez vous, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai voulu ce qui est arrivé.” » Ils obéirent à la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et rentrèrent chez eux, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait dit.
fr.R: “Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : N’allez pas faire la guerre contre vos frères, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}. Rentrez tous chez vous. C’est {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} qui ai fait arriver tout cela.” » Ils ont donc obéi à la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils sont rentrés chez eux, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le leur avait dit.

sw.L: '{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Msipande, wala msipigane na ndugu zenu, wana wa Israeli. Rudini, kila mtu nyumbani kwake, kwa maana jambo hili limetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.'" Wakalisikiliza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakarudi kwenda [nyumbani], sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: 'Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Msiende kupigana na ndugu zenu, Waisraeli. Rudini nyumbani, kila mmoja wenu, kwa maana jambo hili limetoka {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.'" Basi wakalitii neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakarudi nyumbani, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema.
sw.R: 'Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Msiende vitani kupigana na ndugu zenu, Waisraeli. Nyote rudini nyumbani. Mimi ndiye niliyefanya jambo hili litokee.'" Basi wakalitii neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakarudi nyumbani, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyowaambia.

vi.L: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Các ngươi chớ đi lên, và chớ giao chiến với anh em mình là con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên. Mỗi người hãy trở về nhà mình, vì việc này đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Họ nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và quay về [nhà] theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: '{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Đừng đi lên đánh anh em bà con của các ngươi là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Mọi người hãy trở về nhà, vì việc này là do {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Vậy họ vâng theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trở về nhà, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán.
vi.R: 'Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Đừng đi đánh anh em bà con của các ngươi là dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Mọi người hãy về nhà đi. Chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm cho việc này xảy ra.'" Vậy họ vâng theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trở về nhà, đúng như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền dạy.

ko.L: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 너희는 올라가지 말고, 너희 형제 이스라엘 자손과 싸우지 말아라. 각 사람은 자기 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 나에게서 나온 것이다.'" 그러자 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 듣고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 [집으로] 가려고 돌아갔다.
ko.B: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 너희 친척인 이스라엘 자손과 싸우러 올라가지 말아라. 모두 자기 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 내가 일으킨 것이다.'" 그러자 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 듣고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: '{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 너희 친척인 이스라엘 자손과 싸우러 가지 말아라. 모두 집으로 돌아가라. 이 일은 내가 일어나게 한 것이다.'" 그러자 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀에 순종하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하신 대로 집으로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Vocês não subirão e não lutarão contra os seus irmãos, os filhos de Israel. Voltem, cada um para a sua casa, porque esta coisa veio de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.'" E eles ouviram a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e voltaram para ir [para casa], conforme a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: 'Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Não subam para lutar contra os seus parentes, os israelitas. Voltem para casa, cada um de vocês, pois isto veio de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.'" Eles obedeceram à palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e voltaram para casa, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha dito.
pt.R: 'É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Não vão à guerra contra os seus parentes, os israelitas. Vão todos para casa. Fui eu que fiz isto acontecer.'" Então eles obedeceram à palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e foram para casa, exatamente como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes tinha dito.

am.L: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ አትውጡ፤ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ከእስራኤል ልጆችም ጋር አትዋጉ፤ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ፤ ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ሆኗልና።”» እነርሱም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ሰሙ፤ እንደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ቃልም ለመሄድ ተመለሱ።
am.B: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ ከወንድሞቻችሁ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር ለመዋጋት አትውጡ። ሁላችሁም ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ፤ ይህ ነገር ከእኔ ዘንድ ነውና።”» እነርሱም {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ሰሙ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዳለውም ወደ ቤታቸው ተመለሱ።
am.R: “{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚለው ይህ ነው፦ ከወገኖቻችሁ ከእስራኤላውያን ጋር ለመዋጋት አትሂዱ። ሁላችሁም ወደ ቤታችሁ ተመለሱ። ይህ እንዲሆን ያደረግሁት እኔ ነኝ።”» ስለዚህ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔርን|የያህዌን}} ቃል ታዘዙ፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ነገራቸውም ወደ ቤታቸው ተመለሱ።

hi.L: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: तुम चढ़ाई न करना और अपने भाइयों, {{gender:इस्राएल की सन्तान|इस्राएल के पुत्रों}} से न लड़ना। तुम में से हर एक अपने घर लौट जाए, क्योंकि यह बात मेरी ही ओर से हुई है।'" और उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन माना, और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के वचन के अनुसार [घर] लौट गए।
hi.B: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: अपने भाई-बंधुओं, इस्राएलियों, से लड़ने के लिए चढ़ाई न करो। तुम में से हर एक अपने घर लौट जाए, क्योंकि यह बात मेरी ओर से हुई है।'" तब उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन माना और {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के कहे अनुसार घर लौट गए।
hi.R: '{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: अपने भाई-बंधुओं, इस्राएलियों, से युद्ध करने मत जाओ। तुम सब अपने-अपने घर लौट जाओ। यह सब मैंने ही होने दिया है।'" तब उन्होंने {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन माना और घर लौट गए, जैसा {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने उनसे कहा था।

ru.L: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Не поднимайтесь и не сражайтесь с вашими братьями, {{gender:детьми Израиля|сынами Израиля}}. Возвращайтесь каждый в свой дом, потому что от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} было это дело.”» И они послушали слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и вернулись, чтобы идти [домой], по слову {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: “Так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Не идите войной на своих братьев, израильтян. Возвращайтесь каждый домой, потому что это сделал {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}.”» И они послушались слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и вернулись домой, как сказал {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: “Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: Не воюйте со своими братьями, израильтянами. Все идите домой. Это {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал так, чтобы это случилось.”» И они послушались слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и пошли домой, как велел им {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: 『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたがたは上って行ってはならない。あなたがたの兄弟、イスラエルの子らと戦ってはならない。おのおの自分の家に帰りなさい。このことはわたしから出たのだから。』」そこで彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉に聞き従い、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉のとおりに引き返して[家に]帰って行った。
ja.B: 『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。上って行って、あなたがたの同胞であるイスラエルの人々と戦ってはならない。それぞれ自分の家に帰りなさい。このことは、わたしが起こしたのである。』」そこで彼らは{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉に聞き従い、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が言われたとおり家に帰って行った。
ja.R: 『{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。あなたたちの親族であるイスラエルの人々と戦いに行ってはいけない。みな家に帰りなさい。このことを起こしたのは、わたしである。』」それで人々は、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉に従い、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に言われたとおり、家に帰って行きました。

uk.L: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Не йдіть і не воюйте з вашими братами, {{gender:нащадками Ізраїля|синами Ізраїля}}. Поверніться кожен до свого дому, бо від {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} сталася ця річ”». І послухали вони слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і повернулися, щоб іти [додому], за словом {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНІМ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: “Так говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Не йдіть воювати проти своїх родичів, ізраїльтян. Ідіть кожен додому, бо це сталося з {{deity_pronoun:моєї|Моєї}} волі”». Тож вони послухали слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і повернулися додому, як сказав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.R: “Ось що говорить {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}: Не йдіть на війну проти своїх родичів, ізраїльтян. Ідіть усі додому. Це Я зробив так, щоб це сталося”». Тож вони послухалися слова {{divine_name:ГОСПОДНЬОГО|Ягве}} і пішли додому, як {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} їм і сказав.

decisions.choice: this has come from me: the LORD owns the division
decisions.reason: As verse 15 says, the split of the kingdom is the LORD's doing. To fight it would be to fight against him.

decisions.choice: your brothers: your own kin
decisions.reason: "Brothers" here means fellow members of one people, descended from Jacob's sons. The war would be a war within one family.

decisions.choice: go up and fight: march to war
decisions.reason: To "go up" is often to set out on a campaign; the two verbs together mean "march out to fight".

decisions.choice: they listened and turned back
decisions.reason: The army obeys at once. The story of the division ends with Judah accepting God's word, though there was fighting between the two kingdoms later (14:30; 15:6).

decisions.choice: relatives
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "relatives" to show that "brothers" means kin, not only brothers born of the same parents; Literal keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD; The LORD says this; This is what the LORD says
decisions.reason: The prophet's formula is worded the same way at each level throughout Samuel, Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el SEÑOR" (L); "El SEÑOR dice esto" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as the Samuel note sets for Spanish, one wording per level; God's words take “ ” inside the prophet's « ».

decisions.choice: "Yo soy quien hizo que esto sucediera", with no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: Readable carries the pronoun in the verb and the plain "Yo", which Spanish never capitalizes, so the English span on "me" has no Spanish counterpart here.

decisions.choice: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR" (L); "Le SEIGNEUR dit ceci" (B); "Voici ce que dit le SEIGNEUR" (R)
alternatives: "Ainsi parle le SEIGNEUR" at every level
decisions.reason: The prophet’s formula as the Samuel terms note sets it, one wording per level for the whole block.

decisions.choice: "vos frères" (B, R)
decisions.reason: French "frères" is used naturally of fellow members of one people, so Balanced and Readable keep it where the English says "relatives"; "parents" would suggest close family.

decisions.choice: BWANA asema hivi (Literal); Hivi ndivyo BWANA asemavyo (Balanced); Hili ndilo BWANA analosema (Readable)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula has one wording per level through these books, as the Swahili of 2 Samuel settled it.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} (Literal, Balanced); Mimi ndiye (Readable)
decisions.reason: God's "me" is the joined pronoun "kwangu", which takes the span as the style guide sets; at Readable "Mimi" begins the sentence and is written plainly with its capital.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán thế này" (L); "CHÚA phán như vầy" (B); "Đây là lời CHÚA phán" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's wording of the messenger formula at each level, kept through Kings.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and "các ngươi" to the people
decisions.reason: As in Samuel when God speaks to the people in a message of command; "Ta" takes the deity_pronoun span mid-sentence and is written plainly at a sentence start.

decisions.choice: "주께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "하시는 말씀이다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel wording for the messenger formula, held through the block; it avoids the archaic endings of the older Bibles.

decisions.choice: os seus irmãos (L); os seus parentes (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Irmãos" is kept at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "parentes", as the English says "relatives", since the war would be within one family (m2). The LORD speaks to the people in the plural with "vocês"; the messenger formula as 13:2 sets it for the book. Readable has no deity span on "eu", as the style guide sets for the first person.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦" (Literal, Balanced); "... የሚለው ይህ ነው፦" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as the terms list for Kings sets it and as the Amharic Samuel has it at Readable; the same wording for every "Thus says the LORD" in 1 Kings.

decisions.choice: "यों कहते हैं" (L); "यह कहते हैं" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The messenger formula as 11:31.
Your brothers means your own kin (meaning m2); Balanced and Readable say "भाई-बंधु", as the English says relatives.

decisions.choice: "братьями"
decisions.reason: Russian "братья" carries kin as well as brothers (m2), so it stays at every level where the English Balanced says "relatives".

decisions.choice: acheikhem bene yisra'el "あなたがたの兄弟、イスラエルの子ら" (L), "同胞であるイスラエルの人々" (B), "親族であるイスラエルの人々" (R), no gender spans
decisions.reason: The English spans children|sons and Israelites|sons; the Japanese words include men and women. 兄弟 at Literal is the kin word (your own kin), as "brothers" for comrades in 1SA 30:23.

source.text: וַיִּ֨בֶן יָרָבְעָ֧ם אֶת־שְׁכֶ֛ם בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֖יִם וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב בָּ֑הּ וַיֵּצֵ֣א מִשָּׁ֔ם וַיִּ֖בֶן אֶת־פְּנוּאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And built Jeroboam Shechem in [the] hill country of Ephraim and dwelt in it, and went out from there and built Penuel.

en.L: And Jeroboam built Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived in it; and he went out from there and built Penuel.
en.B: Jeroboam fortified Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim and lived there. From there he went out and fortified Penuel.
en.R: Jeroboam made the town of Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim stronger, and he lived there. Then he went out from there and made the town of Penuel stronger too.

es.L: Y Jeroboam edificó Siquem en la región montañosa de Efraín y habitó en ella; y salió de allí y edificó Penuel.
es.B: Jeroboam fortificó Siquem, en la región montañosa de Efraín, y vivió allí. Desde allí salió y fortificó Penuel.
es.R: Jeroboam hizo más fuerte la ciudad de Siquem, en la región montañosa de Efraín, y vivió allí. Luego salió de allí e hizo más fuerte también la ciudad de Penuel.

fr.L: Et Jéroboam bâtit Sichem dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm et y habita ; et il sortit de là et bâtit Penouel.
fr.B: Jéroboam fortifia Sichem, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm, et il s’y établit. Puis il en sortit et fortifia Penouel.
fr.R: Jéroboam a rendu plus forte la ville de Sichem, dans la région montagneuse d’Éphraïm, et il s’y est installé. Ensuite il est parti de là et il a aussi rendu plus forte la ville de Penouel.

sw.L: Yeroboamu akaijenga Shekemu katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, akakaa ndani yake; akatoka huko akaijenga Penueli.
sw.B: Yeroboamu aliuimarisha mji wa Shekemu katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu, akakaa huko. Kutoka huko akaenda, akauimarisha mji wa Penueli.
sw.R: Yeroboamu aliufanya mji wa Shekemu katika nchi ya milima ya Efraimu kuwa imara zaidi, akaishi huko. Kisha akatoka huko, akaufanya mji wa Penueli kuwa imara pia.

vi.L: Giê-rô-bô-am xây Si-chem trên miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im và ở tại đó; rồi ông ra khỏi đó và xây Phê-nu-ên.
vi.B: Giê-rô-bô-am củng cố thành Si-chem trên miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im và ở tại đó. Từ đó ông đi ra và củng cố thành Phê-nu-ên.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am xây cho thành Si-chem trên miền đồi núi Ép-ra-im vững mạnh hơn, và ông ở tại đó. Rồi ông đi ra khỏi đó và cũng xây cho thành Phê-nu-ên vững mạnh hơn.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암이 에브라임 산지의 세겜을 건축하고 거기에 살았다. 그리고 그가 거기서 나가서 브누엘을 건축했다.
ko.B: 여로보암은 에브라임 산지의 세겜을 요새로 만들고 그곳에 살았다. 그리고 그곳에서 나가서 브누엘도 요새로 만들었다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 에브라임 산간 지방에 있는 세겜이라는 성읍을 더 튼튼하게 하고, 그곳에서 살았다. 그 뒤에 그곳에서 나가서 브누엘이라는 성읍도 튼튼하게 했다.

pt.L: E Jeroboão edificou Siquém, na região montanhosa de Efraim, e habitou nela; e saiu dali e edificou Penuel.
pt.B: Jeroboão fortificou Siquém, na região montanhosa de Efraim, e morou ali. Dali ele saiu e fortificou Penuel.
pt.R: Jeroboão tornou mais forte a cidade de Siquém, na região montanhosa de Efraim, e morou ali. Depois saiu dali e tornou mais forte também a cidade de Penuel.

am.L: ኢዮርብዓምም በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ሴኬምን ሠራ፤ በእርሷም ተቀመጠ፤ ከዚያም ወጥቶ ፋኑኤልን ሠራ።
am.B: ኢዮርብዓም በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን ሴኬምን መሽጎ በዚያ ተቀመጠ፤ ከዚያም ወጥቶ ፋኑኤልን መሸገ።
am.R: ኢዮርብዓም በኤፍሬም ተራራማ አገር ያለችውን የሴኬምን ከተማ አጠናከረ፤ በዚያም ኖረ። ከዚያም ወጥቶ የፋኑኤልን ከተማ ደግሞ አጠናከረ።

hi.L: और यारोबाम ने एप्रैम के पहाड़ी देश में शकेम को बनाया और उसमें रहने लगा; और वहाँ से निकलकर उसने पनूएल को बनाया।
hi.B: यारोबाम ने एप्रैम के पहाड़ी देश में शकेम को दृढ़ किया और वहीं रहने लगा। फिर उसने वहाँ से निकलकर पनूएल को दृढ़ किया।
hi.R: यारोबाम ने एप्रैम के पहाड़ी देश में शकेम नगर को मज़बूत किया और वहाँ रहने लगा। फिर उसने वहाँ से जाकर पनूएल नगर को भी मज़बूत किया।

ru.L: И построил Иеровоам Сихем в нагорье Ефрема и жил в нём; и вышел оттуда и построил Пенуэл.
ru.B: Иеровоам укрепил Сихем в нагорье Ефрема и поселился там. Оттуда он вышел и укрепил Пенуэл.
ru.R: Иеровоам сделал город Сихем в горах Ефрема более сильной крепостью и жил там. Потом он ушёл оттуда и укрепил город Пенуэл.

ja.L: そしてヤロブアムはエフライムの山地のシケムを建てて、そこに住んだ。また、そこから出て行って、ペヌエルを建てた。
ja.B: ヤロブアムはエフライムの山地にあるシケムを堅固にして、そこに住んだ。また、そこから出て行ってペヌエルを堅固にした。
ja.R: ヤロブアムは、エフライムの山地にあるシケムの町を強くして、そこに住みました。それから、ペヌエルの町にも行って、そこも強くしました。

uk.L: І збудував Єровоам Сихем у горах Єфрема і жив у ньому; і вийшов звідти, і збудував Пенуел.
uk.B: Єровоам укріпив Сихем у горах Єфрема і жив там. Звідти він вийшов і укріпив Пенуел.
uk.R: Єровоам зміцнив місто Сихем у горах Єфрема і жив там. Потім він вийшов звідти і зміцнив також місто Пенуел.

decisions.choice: built: rebuilt and fortified
decisions.reason: Shechem and Penuel were old towns, so "built" means that Jeroboam rebuilt them and strengthened their walls. Both had been destroyed in Gideon's and Abimelech's days (Judges 8:17; 9:45).

decisions.choice: Penuel: a town east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Penuel lay by the Jabbok River east of the Jordan, where Jacob wrestled with God (Genesis 32:31-32). Fortifying it guarded the eastern part of Jeroboam's kingdom.

decisions.choice: went out from there
decisions.reason: This may mean that Jeroboam went out on a campaign from Shechem, or that he later moved his residence. The text does not say which.

decisions.choice: fortified; made stronger
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "built" means for towns that already stood.

decisions.choice: "fortificó" (B); "hizo más fuerte" (R); "edificó" (L)
decisions.reason: The verb is "build", here of rebuilding and strengthening towns that already stood; Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Penouel"
decisions.reason: The French spelling of the place where Jacob wrestled, as in the French Pentateuch (Genesis 32:32).

decisions.choice: "Phê-nu-ên"
decisions.reason: The form Genesis 32:32 uses for Penuel, kept apart from Peniel (32:31).

decisions.choice: "ፋኑኤል" (Penuel), as in the Amharic Genesis 32 and Judges 8
decisions.reason: Same place, same form.

decisions.choice: "बनाया" (L); "दृढ़ किया" (B); "मज़बूत किया" (R)
decisions.reason: To build a standing town is to rebuild and fortify it (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "पनूएल"
decisions.reason: The form of Genesis 32:32 and Judges 8:8 in this translation.

decisions.choice: "Пенуэл"; "нагорье Ефрема" (L, B), "горы Ефрема" (R)
decisions.reason: Penuel as Judges 8 in this translation; the hill country as 1 Samuel 1:1 and 2 Samuel 20:21.

decisions.choice: banah "建て" (L), "堅固にして" (B), "強くして" (R); Penuel "ペヌエル"
decisions.reason: Built here means rebuilt and fortified, as 9:17; Penuel as GEN 32 and JDG 8.

source.text: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּלִבּ֑וֹ עַתָּ֛ה תָּשׁ֥וּב הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Jeroboam in his heart, Now will return the kingdom to [the] house of David.

en.L: And Jeroboam said in his heart, "Now the kingdom will return to the house of David.
en.B: Jeroboam thought to himself, "As things are, the kingdom will go back to the house of David.
en.R: But Jeroboam was worried. He thought, "The way things are going, the kingdom will go back to David's family.

es.L: Y dijo Jeroboam en su corazón: «Ahora volverá el reino a la casa de David.
es.B: Jeroboam pensó: «Tal como están las cosas, el reino volverá a la casa de David.
es.R: Pero Jeroboam estaba preocupado. Pensó: «Tal como van las cosas, el reino volverá a la familia de David.

fr.L: Et Jéroboam dit dans son cœur : « Maintenant la royauté va retourner à la maison de David.
fr.B: Jéroboam se dit en lui-même : « Au point où en sont les choses, le royaume va revenir à la maison de David.
fr.R: Mais Jéroboam était inquiet. Il pensait : « Si les choses continuent ainsi, le royaume va revenir à la famille de David.

sw.L: Yeroboamu akasema moyoni mwake, "Sasa ufalme utarudi kwa nyumba ya Daudi.
sw.B: Yeroboamu akawaza moyoni, "Kwa jinsi mambo yalivyo, ufalme utarudi kwa nyumba ya Daudi.
sw.R: Lakini Yeroboamu alikuwa na wasiwasi. Akawaza, "Kwa jinsi mambo yanavyokwenda, ufalme utarudi kwa jamaa ya Daudi.

vi.L: Giê-rô-bô-am nói trong lòng mình: "Bây giờ vương quốc sẽ trở về nhà Đa-vít.
vi.B: Giê-rô-bô-am tự nghĩ: "Cứ đà này, vương quốc sẽ trở về với nhà Đa-vít.
vi.R: Nhưng Giê-rô-bô-am lo lắng. Ông nghĩ: "Cứ theo tình hình này, vương quốc sẽ trở về với dòng dõi Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암이 그의 마음속으로 말했다. "이제 나라가 다윗의 집으로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: 여로보암은 속으로 생각했다. "이대로 가면 나라가 다윗 집안으로 돌아가고 말 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 여로보암은 걱정이 되었다. 그는 이렇게 생각했다. "이대로 가면 나라가 다윗의 집안으로 다시 넘어갈 것이다.

pt.L: E Jeroboão disse no seu coração: "Agora o reino voltará para a casa de Davi.
pt.B: Jeroboão pensou consigo mesmo: "Do jeito que as coisas estão, o reino vai voltar para a casa de Davi.
pt.R: Mas Jeroboão estava preocupado. Ele pensou: "Do jeito que as coisas vão, o reino vai voltar para a família de Davi.

am.L: ኢዮርብዓምም በልቡ እንዲህ አለ፦ «አሁን መንግሥቱ ወደ ዳዊት ቤት ይመለሳል።
am.B: ኢዮርብዓም በልቡ እንዲህ አሰበ፦ «አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ መንግሥቱ ወደ ዳዊት ቤት ይመለሳል።
am.R: ኢዮርብዓም ግን ተጨነቀ። እንዲህም ብሎ አሰበ፦ «ነገሩ በዚህ ከቀጠለ መንግሥቱ ወደ ዳዊት ቤተሰብ ይመለሳል።

hi.L: और यारोबाम ने अपने मन में कहा, "अब राज्य दाऊद के घराने को लौट जाएगा।
hi.B: यारोबाम ने मन ही मन सोचा, "जैसी स्थिति है, राज्य फिर से दाऊद के घराने के हाथ चला जाएगा।
hi.R: पर यारोबाम को चिंता हुई। उसने सोचा, "जिस तरह बातें चल रही हैं, राज्य फिर से दाऊद के परिवार के पास चला जाएगा।

ru.L: И сказал Иеровоам в своём сердце: «Теперь вернётся царство к дому Давида.
ru.B: Иеровоам подумал: «Если так пойдёт и дальше, царство вернётся к дому Давида.
ru.R: Но Иеровоам был обеспокоен. Он думал: «Если так пойдёт и дальше, царство вернётся к семье Давида.

ja.L: そしてヤロブアムは心の中で言った。「今、王国はダビデの家に戻るだろう。
ja.B: ヤロブアムは心の中で考えた。「このままでは、王国はダビデの家に戻ってしまう。
ja.R: けれども、ヤロブアムは心配になって、こう考えました。「このままでは、王国はダビデの家族に戻ってしまう。

uk.L: І сказав Єровоам у своєму серці: «Тепер повернеться царство до дому Давида.
uk.B: Єровоам подумав собі: «Як воно йде, царство повернеться до дому Давида.
uk.R: Але Єровоам непокоївся. Він думав: «Якщо так піде й далі, царство повернеться до родини Давида.

decisions.choice: said in his heart: thought to himself
decisions.reason: The heart is the seat of thought; to say something in one's heart is to think it without speaking.

decisions.choice: now: as matters stand
decisions.reason: "Now" here points to the present state of things: if nothing changes, the kingdom will go back to David's house. Jeroboam fears this, though the LORD had promised him a lasting house if he obeyed (11:38).

decisions.choice: was worried
decisions.reason: Readable states the fear that the following words express.

decisions.choice: amar belibbo "心の中で言った" (L), "心の中で考えた" (B), "考えました" (R)
decisions.reason: Speech to oneself takes 「 」 as the English quotation marks, kept open into verse 27.

source.text: אִֽם־יַעֲלֶ֣ה׀הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֨וֹת זְבָחִ֤ים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְ֠שָׁב לֵ֣ב הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֶל־אֲדֹ֣נֵיהֶ֔ם אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֖ם מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה וַהֲרָגֻ֕נִי וְשָׁ֖בוּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֥ם מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: If goes up the people the this to make sacrifices in [the] house of Yahweh in Jerusalem, then will return [the] heart of the people the this to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.

en.L: If this people goes up to make sacrifices in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, then the heart of this people will turn back to their lord, to Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah."
en.B: If these people go up to offer sacrifices at the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, their hearts will turn back to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah, and they will kill me and go back to Rehoboam king of Judah."
en.R: If these people keep going to Jerusalem to offer sacrifices at the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, they will start to feel loyal again to their old master, Rehoboam king of Judah. They will kill me and go back to King Rehoboam."

es.L: Si este pueblo sube a ofrecer sacrificios en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, el corazón de este pueblo se volverá a su señor, a Roboam rey de Judá, y me matarán y volverán a Roboam rey de Judá».
es.B: Si esta gente sube a ofrecer sacrificios en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, su corazón se volverá a su señor, Roboam rey de Judá, y me matarán y volverán con Roboam rey de Judá».
es.R: Si esta gente sigue yendo a Jerusalén a ofrecer sacrificios en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, volverán a sentirse leales a su antiguo amo, Roboam rey de Judá. Me matarán y volverán con el rey Roboam».

fr.L: Si ce peuple monte pour faire des sacrifices dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, alors le cœur de ce peuple retournera vers leur seigneur, vers Roboam roi de Juda, et ils me tueront et retourneront à Roboam roi de Juda. »
fr.B: Si ce peuple monte offrir des sacrifices dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Jérusalem, son cœur se tournera de nouveau vers son seigneur, Roboam, roi de Juda ; on me tuera et on retournera à Roboam, roi de Juda. »
fr.R: Si ces gens continuent d’aller à Jérusalem pour offrir des sacrifices au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ils vont redevenir fidèles à leur ancien maître, Roboam, roi de Juda. Ils me tueront et ils retourneront au roi Roboam. »

sw.L: Ikiwa watu hawa watapanda kutoa dhabihu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu, ndipo moyo wa watu hawa utarudi kwa bwana wao, kwa Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda, nao wataniua na kurudi kwa Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda."
sw.B: Ikiwa watu hawa watakwenda kutoa dhabihu katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Yerusalemu, mioyo yao itarudi kwa bwana wao, Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda, nao wataniua na kurudi kwa Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda."
sw.R: Kama watu hawa wataendelea kwenda Yerusalemu kutoa dhabihu katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wataanza tena kuwa waaminifu kwa bwana wao wa zamani, Rehoboamu mfalme wa Yuda. Wataniua na kurudi kwa mfalme Rehoboamu."

vi.L: Nếu dân này đi lên dâng sinh tế trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, thì lòng dân này sẽ quay về với chúa của họ, là Rô-bô-am vua Giu-đa, rồi họ sẽ giết ta và trở về với Rô-bô-am vua Giu-đa."
vi.B: Nếu dân này đi lên dâng sinh tế tại nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, lòng họ sẽ quay về với chủ của họ là Rô-bô-am vua Giu-đa; họ sẽ giết ta và trở về với Rô-bô-am vua Giu-đa."
vi.R: Nếu dân này cứ đi Giê-ru-sa-lem để dâng sinh tế tại đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, họ sẽ lại trung thành với chủ cũ của họ là Rô-bô-am vua Giu-đa. Họ sẽ giết ta và trở về với vua Rô-bô-am."

ko.L: 만일 이 백성이 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제사를 드리러 올라가면, 이 백성의 마음이 그들의 주인, 곧 유다 왕 르호보암에게로 돌아갈 것이다. 그리고 그들은 나를 죽이고 유다 왕 르호보암에게로 돌아갈 것이다."
ko.B: 이 백성이 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 제사를 드리러 올라가면, 그들의 마음이 자기들의 주인인 유다 왕 르호보암에게로 돌아갈 것이다. 그러면 그들은 나를 죽이고 유다 왕 르호보암에게로 돌아갈 것이다."
ko.R: 이 백성이 계속 예루살렘에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 제사를 드리러 가면, 그들은 옛 주인인 유다 왕 르호보암에게 다시 마음이 기울 것이다. 그러면 그들은 나를 죽이고 르호보암 왕에게 돌아갈 것이다."

pt.L: Se este povo subir para oferecer sacrifícios na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, então o coração deste povo voltará para o seu senhor, para Roboão, rei de Judá, e eles me matarão e voltarão para Roboão, rei de Judá."
pt.B: Se este povo subir para oferecer sacrifícios na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Jerusalém, o seu coração voltará para o seu senhor, Roboão, rei de Judá, e eles me matarão e voltarão para Roboão, rei de Judá."
